primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Responses were measured on a 100-mm Visual Analogue Scale (VAS), where the left endpoint was marked "no itch" (0 mm) and in the right endpoint was marked "worst imaginable itch" (100 mm).
primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: All participants randomized (1:1) to placebo or tradipitant.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Mean Change From Baseline in Pruritus Symptoms, as Measured by the 24-hour Average Pruritus Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) Score
